name: Purple Dragon Commandant

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Bonus Action: a visible ally within 30 feet gains 2d6 + the raised ability's modifier Temporary Hit Points. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest. While Bloodied, your attack rolls have Advantage.

benefits.name: Rallying Command
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: a visible ally within 30 feet gains 2d6 + the raised ability's modifier Temporary Hit Points. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action, choose an ally you can see within 30 feet: it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus the modifier of the ability this feat increased. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Bloodied Fury
benefits.summary: While Bloodied, your attack rolls have Advantage.
benefits.text: While you are Bloodied, you have Advantage on attack rolls.

prerequisites.text: Level 4+, Purple Dragon Rook or Martial weapon training
